the-force.text: (The Force is with you. When you use the Force, remove this token from play.)

acolyte-of-the-beyond.text: On Attack/When Defeated: The Force is with you .

karis--we-don-t-like-strangers.text: When Defeated: You may use the Force . If you do, give a unit –2/–2 for this phase.

talzin-s-assassin.text: When Played: You may use the Force (lose your Force token). If you do, give a unit –3/–3 for this phase.

darth-tyranus--servant-of-sidious.text:
Shielded 
While the Force is with you, this unit gains Ambush.

shatterpoint.text:
Choose one:
Defeat a non-leader unit with 3 or less remaining HP.
Use the Force . If you do, defeat a non-leader unit.

nightsister-lair.text: When a friendly Force unit attacks: The Force is with you (create your Force token).

darth-maul--sith-revealed.text: Action [Exhaust, use the Force (lose your Force token)]: Deal 1 damage to a unit and 1 damage to a different unit.
darth-maul--sith-revealed.epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 6 or more resources, deploy this leader.
darth-maul--sith-revealed.deployBox: On Attack: Deal 1 damage to a unit and 1 damage to a different unit.

owen-lars--devoted-uncle.text:
Restore 2
When Defeated: Search the top 5 cards of your deck for a Force unit, reveal it, and draw it. (Put the other cards on the bottom of your deck in a random order.)

constructed-lightsaber.text:
Attach to a Force unit.
If attached unit is a Heroism unit, it gains Restore 2.
If attached unit is a Villainy unit, it gains Raid 2.
If attached unit is a non-Heroism, non-Villainy unit, it gains Sentinel.

sabine-s-lightsaber--not-alone.text:
Attach to a non-Vehicle unit.
If attached unit is Sabine Wren or a Force unit, it gains Restore 2.

luke-s-jedi-lightsaber--constructed-by-h.text:
Attach to a non-Vehicle unit.
If attached unit is Luke Skywalker, he gains Sentinel. (Enemy units in this arena must attack a Sentinel when they attack you.)

devastator--hunting-the-rebellion.text:
You assign all indirect damage you deal to opponents.
When Played: Deal 4 indirect damage to each opponent.

hunting-aggressor.text: Indirect damage you deal to opponents is increased by 1.

planetary-bombardment.text: Deal 8 indirect damage to a player. If you control a Capital Ship unit, deal 12 indirect damage instead.

droid-missile-platform.text: When Defeated: Deal 3 indirect damage to a player. (They assign 3 unpreventable damage among their base and units.)

tie-bomber.text: On Attack: Deal 3 indirect damage to the defending player. (They assign 3 unpreventable damage among their base and units.)

red-squadron-y-wing.text: On Attack: Deal 3 indirect damage to the defending player. (They assign 3 unpreventable damage among their base and units.)

first-order-stormtrooper.text: On Attack/When Defeated: Deal 1 indirect damage to a player. (They assign 1 unpreventable damage among their base and units.)

zygerrian-starhopper.text: When Defeated: Deal 2 indirect damage to a player. (They assign 2 unpreventable damage among their base and units.)

fett-s-firespray--feared-silhouette.text: When Played/On Attack: Deal 1 indirect damage to a player. If you control Boba Fett (as a unit, upgrade, or leader), deal 2 indirect damage instead. (They assign unpreventable damage among their base and units.)

allegiant-general-pryde--ruthless-and-lo.text:
When indirect damage is dealt to a unit: You may defeat a non-unique upgrade on it.
On Attack: If you have the initiative, deal 2 indirect damage to a player.
